localBiteReport: The most recent datable catch report from the Choctawhatchee Bay area (FishingBooker, approximately mid-November 2026) confirms redfish are actively biting, with anglers landing keeper fish on guided bay trips out of the Freeport/Santa Rosa Beach area. A late-October report from Capt. Blake Nelson (Last Cast Charters) noted productive redfish sight-fishing on the Choctawhatchee Bay flats, with smaller fish (under ~23 inches) holding in guts, potholes, and shallow feeding areas; fish were feeding heavily on shrimp, tiny crabs, and worms, making bottom-oriented presentations like a Ned rig effective. Water temperature as of today (Nov 20) is 70°F. Half Hitch Destin posted their most recent weekly report on November 16, 2026, but its full bay-fishing content was not retrievable; their November seasonal forecast consistently highlights flounder, sheepshead, and redfish as top bay targets this month, with sheepshead picking up around bridges and structure as water cools.
